subject: Substring-based Transliteration
source_sentence: Wang and Tsai (2011) adopt the substring-based transliteration approach which groups the characters of named entity in both source and target languages into substrings and then formulate the transliteration as a sequential tagging problem to tag the substrings in the source language with the substrings in the target language.
title: Report of NEWS 2011 Machine Transliteration Shared Task
